title: Sidi Ali Bou Arrar
description: Remains of a villa and associated cisterns, now built over by modern structures, occupy a high point about 1200 meters south of modern Sidi Moussa in Algeria's Tipaza province and north of the marabout of Sidi Ali bou Arrar.
